column1: # Rows db.html.rps.* (line RG T4c, 2026-11-24): rpsblast with -html, NCBI's bytes of formats 0, 1, 3, 18 and 6 (html ignored) over the profile databases of ../db_search/rps (rps_mini = gnl|CDD ids, xp = profile 101 as ref|XP_000101.1| (xp101.*.gz), hx = ref|XP_000101.1| with a title holding < > & and double quotes, pdb|1ABC|A and a title with entities (hx.*.gz, build.sh there), the three-volume alias rps_mini3v, rps_cdd, rpscol with the taxonomy database ../seqdb/taxdb/good for format 18), queries ../fasta/rps (xoj, mask, col_qp), the options -show_gis, -num_alignments 0, -num_descriptions 0, -seg and -lcase_masking spans, and the registry and environment rows (cwd= run directories of ../db_search/html/rc: repeated ./.ncbirc entry with the posts naming [rpsblast], GETURL_DEBUG, LOCAL_ID, a malformed ./.ncbirc and a malformed InitConfig). Frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 on ws (env_blast); the rows whose stderr holds an exception trace (a source path, `official binary` in covers) with the local official binary ncbi-blast-2.17.0+. The covers cell names the survey probe (T/t4c, SURVEY_T4c.md section 1).
